executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $270.38 per resident day (48.1% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $8,202,911 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 20,283 Medicaid days, $404.42 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $398.82 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $384.00 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 20.6% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $315,471, 3.2% of the $9,827,283 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,735,677, $47.75 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $814,032 (46.9%), allocated fringe $248,112 (14.3%), non-wage costs $673,533 (38.8%). Raw food was $372,442 ($10.25 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $239,519.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $559,816, $15.4 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $350,354 (62.6%), allocated fringe $106,786 (19.1%), non-wage costs $102,676 (18.3%).
Missing data: cost year 2021 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.formula: (nursing home revenue - nursing home expenses) / revenue

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 17 line(s) of the report, a net increase of $508,722 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Physical Therapy Resident Care (page 13 line B5a), added $528,401; Other Employee Health And Welfare Benefits (page 15 line 1a9), removed $111,908; Speech Therapy Resident Care (page 13 line B9a), added $82,369. Separately, the home itself removed $3,249,887 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

limitations: Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075293/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2021 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (revenue per resident day outside the plausible range; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.

tables.description: What the home reported, what it removed itself, and what DSS's review changed. 'Moved between lines' means the cost was reclassified, not removed. The data does not give reasons.
